product_overview: حاج أيوب أمين is a Quran reading app with audio recitation playback, plus a kids avatar shop for spending points on character customization. It also includes user settings for app updates and protected kids-mode controls.
core_goals: Read and listen to Quran recitations
Select a surah and control audio playback
Customize a kid avatar using available points
Check for app updates and open the release download page
Manage kids mode and related settings

features.name: Quran Reading
features.description: Allows users to browse Quran surahs and listen to recitations with playback controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /reader -> Select a Surah -> Start audio playback -> Adjust repeat or auto-next behavior -> Continue listening to the selected recitation
Navigate to /reader -> Select a Surah -> Start audio playback -> Seek backward or forward -> Skip to the previous or next track -> Continue listening to the selected recitation

features.name: Character Shop
features.description: Lets users view available avatars and spend points to purchase a character customization item.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> View available avatars -> Choose an avatar to purchase -> Confirm the purchase by completing the point deduction -> See the updated avatar selection
Navigate to /shop -> View available avatars -> Choose an avatar to purchase -> See points deduction -> Continue browsing other avatars

features.name: App Settings and Updates
features.description: Provides access to app settings, including checking for updates and following the release download flow when an update is available.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Check for updates -> See update details when a new version is available -> Open the release download page -> Return to the app after downloading
Navigate to /settings -> Check for updates -> See that the app is already up to date
